high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "spaceman.in." The post features a stunning photograph of a spiral galaxy, likely the Milky Way, with its characteristic bright center and swirling arms filled with stars and cosmic dust. The background is a deep black, dotted with numerous stars, enhancing the celestial theme. The text overlay on the image reads: "Similarly, do galaxies orbit around something great?" This question is posed thoughtfully, inviting viewers to ponder the vastness and interconnectedness of the universe.
